claims.claim: Pip explains his name (Pirrip, Philip, Pip)
claims.evidence: Philip Pirrip, late of this parish ... was Pip

claims.claim: graves of parents and five brothers in marsh churchyard
claims.evidence: five little stone lozenges ... five little brothers of mine

claims.claim: a frightening convict suddenly seizes him there
claims.evidence: a man started up from among the graves ... as he seized me by

claims.claim: Pip is an orphan raised by sister and Joe Gargery, a blacksmith
claims.evidence: my sister,—Mrs. Joe Gargery, who married the blacksmith

claims.claim: Pip helps an escaped convict on the marshes
claims.evidence: convict with iron on leg; Pip brings food and file

claims.claim: Miss Havisham has Pip play with Estella, whom he loves
claims.evidence: going to play at Miss Havisham's; Pip's love of Estella throughout

claims.claim: Estella is Miss Havisham's ward
claims.evidence: 'I adopted her, to be loved. I bred her and educated her'; Pip: 'adopted'

claims.claim: Estella is cold
claims.evidence: 'I have no heart'

claims.claim: Jaggers, a London lawyer, tells Pip of a secret benefactor
claims.evidence: I am a lawyer in London ... your liberal benefactor remains a profound secret

claims.claim: Pip goes to London assuming Miss Havisham is benefactor
claims.evidence: whether Miss Havisham intended me for Estella

claims.claim: Pip neglects Joe
claims.evidence: Joe's visit to London, Pip's shame; later forgiveness scene

claims.claim: Benefactor is Magwitch, who returns (alias Provis)
claims.evidence: I took the name of Provis

claims.claim: Pip tries to smuggle him abroad; he is caught and dies
claims.evidence: Magwitch in prison infirmary, 'wasted ... day by day' after trial

claims.claim: Pip falls ill and is nursed by Joe
claims.evidence: Joe sat beside bed; 'Arter you was took ill'

claims.claim: Pip goes abroad with Herbert
claims.evidence: Herbert says 'I fear I shall soon have to leave you ... going to Cairo'; Pip: 'I went out and joined Herbert. Within a month, I had quitted England'

claims.claim: Years later Pip meets Estella in the ruins of Satis House
claims.evidence: we went out of the ruined place ... evening mists

claims.claim: They leave hand in hand, apparently to stay together
claims.evidence: 'I took her hand in mine, and we went out ... no shadow of another parting'
claims.fix: they leave together, seeing no shadow of another parting

claims.claim: Joe Gargery is the blacksmith, Pip's gentle brother-in-law
claims.evidence: Mrs. Joe Gargery, who married the blacksmith

claims.claim: Miss Havisham is a wealthy jilted woman in Satis House
claims.evidence: the wedding dresses were bought ... (line 7085 on)

claims.claim: Mr. Jaggers is a London lawyer
claims.evidence: I am a lawyer in London

claims.claim: Biddy is a village girl who teaches Pip
claims.evidence: Biddy ... immediately said she would [impart all her learning]

claims.claim: Herbert Pocket is Pip's friend in London
claims.evidence: Herbert chapters; Clarriker's
